title: TCG: Shrouded Fable
description: Pecharunt and the Loyal Three rule this mini-set!

questions.question: When was Shrouded Fable released?
questions.explanation: Shrouded Fable launched August 2, 2024 as a special mini set.

questions.question: Which mythical Pokémon is the headline card of Shrouded Fable?
questions.explanation: Pecharunt ex, the Mythical Pokémon from the Mochi Mayhem epilogue, is the star.

questions.question: Shrouded Fable is a special set, not a main expansion.
questions.explanation: It is a special mini-set, similar in style to 151 and Paldean Fates.

questions.question: Which trio appears prominently in Shrouded Fable?
questions.explanation: Okidogi, Munkidori, and Fezandipiti — the Loyal Three — all appear as ex cards.

questions.question: Shrouded Fable features Dusknoir and Dusclops with strong combo potential.
questions.explanation: Dusknoir from Shrouded Fable enables a competitive damage-counter deck.

questions.question: Approximately how many cards are in the Shrouded Fable main set?
questions.explanation: Shrouded Fable has 64 cards in the main set, plus secret rares.

questions.question: Which other character is featured as a Supporter in Shrouded Fable?
questions.explanation: Kieran from The Teal Mask DLC has a Supporter card in Shrouded Fable.

questions.question: Pecharunt ex's attack uses opponents' Bench Pokémon for extra damage.
questions.explanation: Pecharunt ex's Mochi attack does damage based on toxic-related effects on the field.

questions.question: What ACE SPEC card from Shrouded Fable saw heavy competitive play?
questions.explanation: Unfair Stamp resets both players' hands after taking a prize — a powerful disruption ACE SPEC.

questions.question: Shrouded Fable products were heavily impacted by speculation and scalping.
questions.explanation: Like other special sets, demand outstripped supply at launch.
